metadata.description: Answers simple weather questions from built-in knowledge. One agent, no peer links, finishes in 1-2 steps. Baseline clean peer for the Allowance demo.
sample_queries: What is the weather like today?

tools.name: weather_assistant

function.description: Answers simple weather questions. Gives a short, grounded answer and stops.

request.description: The weather question in plain language.

tools.instructions: You are a simple weather assistant. Answer the visitor's weather question in 1-3 sentences using general knowledge. Be concise. Do not call any tools — you have none. Do not ask follow-up questions. After answering, stop.
